title: Q-LESSON-GITHUB-BUDGET: A per-tick GitHub API call budget with Retry-After
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** grep:seed/worker/src/lane.js::Retry-After
**Status:** closed

LESSONS-1 (2026-11-16): from the failure-mode register of the fleet this org was split from (638 entries, classified by root cause).

25 failure modes were external quotas: the shared user's GitHub quota spent, Copilot credits exhausted, null mergeable states retried without limit.

Path: seed/worker/src/lane.js

Acceptance: lane.js and handoff.js count GitHub API calls per tick and stop at a configured cap, and honour Retry-After on 403/429; a test with a mocked 429 proves the backoff.

size: S

**Closing probe:** grep:seed/worker/src/lane.js::Retry-After

**Evidence:** lane.js githubBudget (default 150 GitHub calls per tick, env GITHUB_CALLS_PER_TICK) shared by runLane and runHandoffs through the one gh wrapper; a 403/429 with Retry-After or an exhausted x-ratelimit window stops the tick and records why in out.github. Tests: seed/worker/test/lane.test.js (mocked 429, 403 rules, cap) and handoff.test.js (mocked 429).
